name: x2 assign via class
code:
class B:
    n = 1
B.n = 5
print(B.n, B().n)

name: x3 instance shadows
code:
class C:
    n = 1
c = C()
c.n = 2
print(C.n, c.n)

name: x4 method assigns class attr
code:
class D:
    n = 0
    def inc(self):
        D.n = D.n + 1
d = D()
d.inc()
d.inc()
print(D.n, d.n)

name: x5 shared list via method
code:
class E:
    xs = []
    def add(self, v):
        self.xs.append(v)
e1 = E()
e2 = E()
e1.add(1)
print(e2.xs)

name: x6 count instances
code:

    def __init__(self):
        F.n = F.n + 1
f1 = F()
